description.value: Tofino Resort + Marina is a 63-room waterfront resort situated in the heart of Tofino on unceded Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation territory, with harbour-view rooms and an on-site Adventure Centre offering kayaking, whale watching, bear watching, and fishing charters. The property includes the Shelter Restaurant, Tuff Fit Gym, and a working marina, and is within easy walking distance of Tofino's shops, trails, and eateries. It functions as a full-service West Coast adventure basecamp rather than a simple overnight stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed content about the resort. Laundry and on-site restaurant (Shelter) are confirmed via the FAQ and front-page content respectively. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site. OSM internet_access=yes cannot be confirmed from website text per the rules, so Wi-Fi is left null. Address, phone, and email all match between OSM and website contact page.
concerns: OSM tourism tag is 'motel', which substantially misrepresents a 63-room full-service resort with marina, restaurant, gym, and adventure centre.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating resort in a prime cycling destination, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike-handling procedures can be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether the property meets the core WWC required criteria before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort's Adventure Centre also operates laundry services (call 778.841.0186) and stocks outdoor gear (Yeti, Anian, Xtratuff brands). Pets (dogs only) are welcome for an additional fee. The property is self-described as pet-friendly, which may be relevant to cycle-tourers travelling with dogs.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as 'motel' but the website describes a full 63-room resort with marina, adventure centre, gym, and restaurant—'motel' is a significant under-categorization. No category correction to the WWC schema is needed, but the OSM tag is misleading.

Laundry.detail: FAQ states: 'There is a laundry facility located in the Adventure Centre. Please call 778.841.0186 to inquire about access.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Shelter Restaurant is located on the resort property at 634 Campbell Street; described as offering local wild-caught seafood and other dishes
